claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alclometasone dipropionate is a topical glucocorticoid that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since its pharmacological action is anti-inflammatory GR-mediated gene regulation rather than antiproliferative killing.
